min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
max_r = max(p[0] for p in b)

# Check what changed
if last_transition:
    before = last_transition.before_frame.segmentation
    after = last_transition.after_frame.segmentation
    
    def summarize(seg):
        summary = {}
        for n in seg['nodes']:
            key = (n['color'], n['hash'])
            if key not in summary:
                summary[key] = []
            b = n['boundary']
            min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
            min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
            summary[key].append((n['id'], n['pixels'], (min_r, min_c)))
        return summary
    
    before_sum = summarize(before)
    after_sum = summarize(after)
    
    all_keys = set(before_sum.keys()) | set(after_sum.keys())
    for key in sorted(all_keys):
        b_items = before_sum.get(key, [])
        a_items = after_sum.get(key, [])
        if b_items != a_items:

            print(f"Changed: color={key[0]}, hash={key[1]}")
            print(f"  Before: {b_items}")
            print(f"  After: {a_items}")

print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
